lensFocus.spec: This branch implements docs/plans/2026-11-03-reactions.md for issue .scratch/vecnet/issues/24-reactions.md. Check the fixed emoji set, per-emoji default priority, the opt-in wake layer, coalescing, one wake per (reactor, target, emoji) with operator exempt, no-op 200 changed:false before limits, the response shape (top-level superseded), and every surface (CLI, MCP, TUI, web).
lensFocus.security: Reactions must never become a loop or a covert channel: depth target+1, sender_chain grows, max_depth/expires enforced, rate shared with sends, participants only (from_join), kind reaction refused on /v1/messages and vecnet_send, superseded never pushed. Peer strings inert in web and TUI.
lensFocus.tests: Check screen scripts wait on state, honour SHOTS_DIR, never bind 45752 or 49575; each named plan test exists and fails without its fix; guard tests are marked.
